query:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Customers", DISTINCTCOUNT('dw Custtable'[AccountNum_sk]),
    "Products", DISTINCTCOUNT('dw Inventtable'[ItemId_sk]),
    "InvoiceRows", COUNTROWS('dw FactInvoice'),
    "ForecastRollRows", COUNTROWS(Macs_FC_Roll),
    "BudgetRows", COUNTROWS(Macs_Budget),
    "InvoiceDays", DISTINCTCOUNT('dw FactInvoice'[InvoiceDate_nk]),
    "InvoiceCustomerProductPairs", COUNTROWS(SUMMARIZE('dw FactInvoice', 'dw FactInvoice'[InvoiceAccount_sk], 'dw FactInvoice'[ItemId_sk]))
)
